title: boechera perennans subsp. zephyra
intro: Boechera perennans subsp. zephyra, commonly known as Mountain Rocket, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family and is native to the mountainous regions of North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Boechera perennans subsp. zephyra include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins.
